title: YtShorts Worlds
description: 2 new worlds for youtube shorts videos
body:
This mod adds two unique custom dimensions to Minecraft, perfect for creating eye-catching videos, challenges, and YouTube Shorts.

✨ 1. Diamond & Ore Dimension

A world made entirely of:

💎 Diamond blocks

🟩 Emerald blocks

🟨 Gold blocks

⛏ Other valuable resources

A perfect “rich world” for fun survival challenges and short-form content.

💥 2. TNT Dimension with Ghast Apocalypse

A chaotic dimension where everything — literally everything — is made of:

🧨 TNT

💣 Various explosive blocks

To make it even crazier, massive swarms of Ghasts spawn throughout the world, turning every moment into explosive chaos. Ideal for epic and chaotic video moments.

✅ Features:

Two fully unique, visually striking dimensions

Worlds generate from 100% themed blocks

Extremely high Ghast spawn rate in the TNT dimension

Great for content creators, shorts, challenges, and trolling

Easy access to both dimensions
